scope: two-treatment clean-only recipe diagnostic on a reused 128-image calibration subset
limitations: Historical checkpoint-selection evaluation partition, not a new confirmatory holdout.
Two recipe branches share one frozen 128-image calibration subset and one engine build per treatment; no seed or build-population inference.
No continuation gate is applied: these branches diagnose the remaining clean-fidelity failure rather than authorize a robustness study.
Conv+Add restriction tests quantizable-op coverage, not numerical-format causality; max calibration tests the range estimator under the same input contract.
A successful recipe repair is baseline engineering evidence, not a new robustness method.
